name: rebuilt-dashboards
title: Rebuilt Dashboards
description: Custom-built dashboard shells that establish hierarchy before adding product-specific data.
useWhen: You need a calm, responsive starting structure for an authenticated product surface.
avoidWhen: You need a finished product workflow with domain-specific navigation and data behavior.
responsiveBehavior: The desktop rail becomes a compact header and content remains constrained with consistent page padding.
accessibility: Navigation is contained in a landmark with a visible current destination.
The document keeps a logical heading order and usable focus targets.

variants.title: Dashboard template
variants.description: A complete but intentionally quiet dashboard frame with navigation, heading hierarchy, and summary surfaces.
accessibility: Keep navigation and main content landmarks distinct.

variants.title: Dashboard shell
variants.description: A reusable shell that supplies the content rail, top bar, and responsive surface without product assumptions.
accessibility: Provide a labelled navigation toggle at compact widths.

variants.title: Settings layout
variants.description: A focused settings frame with section navigation and a readable content column for forms.
accessibility: Use section headings and mark the active settings section.
